rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Institutional flows are concentrating in BTC specifically: US spot bitcoin ETFs took +$90.44M on Jul 10 (IBIT alone +$86.83M), a second straight inflow day that snapped a 10-day, $2.73B outflow streak, versus only +$18.4M into spot ETH ETFs and rounding-error inflows into SOL (+$150K) and XRP (+$107K). Cumulative BTC ETF inflows now ~$51.3B. Global crypto cap rose to $2.28T (+1.2% 24h) and Fear & Greed ticked 23 -> 26, but BTC dominance is holding a high 56-58.7%, meaning the recovery bid is selective and flowing to BTC first, not broadly into alts. Optionality: a new combined-committee Clarity Act draft may drop next week with possible Senate floor action the week of Jul 20 — a headline that hits BTC first.
positions.driver: This is a low-edge, fragile-sentiment consolidation day on a weekend tape, and the rulebook says favor the liquid majors when edge is thin. Measured on our own dashboard feed over the last 24h (11:53Z to 11:53Z), NOTHING was strong: BTC -0.40%, ETH -0.10%, SOL -1.60%, XRP -0.35%. With no coin showing genuine relative-strength leadership, the asymmetric choice is the one with the best downside protection and the cleanest catalyst — BTC has the deepest liquidity (smallest weekend gap risk), the rising-dominance bid, and by far the largest share of returning ETF money. Runners-up rejected: ETH (just closed flat at $1,798.41) held up marginally best on the 24h but has now failed twice at the $1,804 resistance shelf and its ETF flows are 5x smaller than BTC's; SOL ($78.02, -1.6%) is the highest-beta name but is the weakest performer overnight and is exactly the wrong profile with BTC dominance rising; XRP ($1.1072, -0.35%) is the YTD momentum leader (+400%) but has stalled and offers no fresh 24h catalyst. Entry = dashboard live feed (asOf 2026-07-11T11:53:05Z).
positions.risks: Sentiment is still in Fear (F&G 26) — this is a short-covering rebound, not a trend, and a macro or regulatory headline over a thin-liquidity weekend could reverse it and trip the 8% stop at $58,999.08. Choosing BTC caps upside: if the Clarity Act draft lands early and sparks a broad alt rotation, high-beta names (SOL, XRP) will materially outperform this pick. Clarity Act path is not clean — ethics, federal preemption and agency vacancies are unresolved, and the bill has already missed its July 4 target, so a 'delayed again' headline is a live downside catalyst. 24/7 headline and dollar/rates risk persists through the weekend.
